relationship_semantics_note: Insurance premium relationships are semantic account links, not symmetric transfer pairs. Card or bank accounts show payment debits; insurance policies show premium-paid status or policy updates where supported.

accounts.downstream_generation_notes: Use this for merchant-level card spends. Credit card payments should be visible as outgoing payments from HDFC or ICICI and matching payment credits in this card account. Do not create duplicate bank debits for card purchases.

required_account_relationships.rule: Most credit card bill payments should debit HDFC salary savings and credit the Axis credit card account. Card spends must not be duplicated as direct bank debits.
Backup card bill payments may debit ICICI secondary savings when Aarav uses buffer money, liquid fund redemption proceeds, or stress-month cash management.
Self-transfers from salary savings to secondary savings must have matching debit and credit entries with plausible timestamp gaps.
Reverse self-transfers must also be traceable across both visible accounts, especially before rent, card bill, or pay-later repayment pressure.
Debit ₹7500 on the 2nd only in 9 successful SIP months. In 3 skipped months there should be no SIP debit.

Liquid fund redemptions should be around ₹30000 and occur twice per year during stress drawdowns. Credit should arrive later than the redemption instruction and must be visible in the destination savings account.
Simpl repayments should usually occur after salary credit and debit HDFC salary savings.
ICICI secondary savings may be used for pay-later repayment in constrained months if Aarav has moved funds or received a redemption credit there.

Food delivery and quick commerce purchases during the final 8 days before salary should increase Simpl outstanding first. Deposit accounts should show impact only when Simpl is repaid. Do not duplicate Simpl purchases as direct bank debits.
Annual scooter insurance premium of ₹7800 should usually appear as a credit card transaction in September.
Annual term insurance premium of ₹15000 may be paid by HDFC net banking in December.
Annual term insurance premium may alternatively appear as a credit card transaction if Aarav chooses card payment in December. Do not generate both payment paths in the same year.
